comments.text: Abandoned places always feel like someone pressed pause on an entire world and never came back to hit play. Empty streets, forgotten buildings, and nature slowly moving in make you wonder about the lives once lived there. Meanwhile, I feel guilty leaving dishes overnight. Which abandoned place would you explore if you had the chance?
